const.label: measured
const.rule: Only exact metric/procedure/revision/environment with complete unexpired bound evidence; do not imply causality or scientific validity.

const.label: verified
const.rule: Only the named bounded probe and represented revision/environment; never every platform, full accessibility, security certification or human approval.

const.label: provider-reported
const.rule: Attribute the provider and date; never relabel as independent measurement or verified compatibility.

const.label: reported
const.rule: Attribute the source; no independent verification or positive check mark.

const.label: estimated
const.rule: Display estimate and method/assumptions; never exact measured fact.

const.label: inferred
const.rule: Label inference and supporting evidence; no independent verification or positive check mark.

const.label: unverified
const.rule: Evidence incomplete or claim not qualified; no success wording.

const.label: stale
const.rule: Historical or superseded/expired evidence; no current support claim.

const.label: blocked
const.rule: Qualification could not complete; distinguish from failed behavior.

const.label: unknown
const.rule: No qualifying knowledge; never zero, unsupported or passing by default.

const.label: not-applicable
const.rule: Explicit scoped reason; not a passing test or earned completion.

freshness.const: Explicit caller clock; expiration, used-evidence retention and supersession downgrade to stale; original declared state and source clocks remain retained.

missing_evidence.const: Strong declared states with incomplete provenance become effectively unverified; do not fabricate raw artifacts, timestamps, dependency versions or verification.

safe_evidence.const: Public URLs are caller-reviewed HTTPS references without credentials/query/fragment; restricted/unavailable evidence uses an opaque evidence:id handle, never raw protected locations.

scientific_limit.const: Structural validation cannot establish actual execution, authenticity, benchmark quality, causality, representativeness or scientific truth. Independent verification requires separate actual proof.

const.aether: AI artifact identity/provenance/authoring; reference exact owner contract
const.relay: approved renderer/workflow integration and report transport; no measurement invention
const.egolint: production structural/semantic claim diagnostics and normalized output
const.observatory: privacy-safe observation/freshness projection; no canonical evidence duplication
const.identity: evidence-linked visual assets/badges, never evidence authority
const.holon: new-repository composition from reviewed compatible pins
const.repository: facts, measurement methods, raw evidence/access/retention, revision scope and publication review

activation_gate.const: Maintainer policy disposition and explicitly reviewed compatible consumers before enforcement; no active policy, fleet compliance or downstream support claimed.

const.limit: Lexical acceptance is not owner-authenticated immutability or execution proof.
